prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE landscape wordless comic illustration in the exact polished glossy 3D children's fairy-tale style of the supplied project images. Scene: in the pearl-and-gold underwater castle, mermaid Odette Ping, Diana Ping and Eclipse Ping stare with quiet wonder into the big magic mirror, while all SEVEN tiny house helpers float around them at different heights. Composition must clearly show their gaze directed at the MIRROR, not at the viewer: three-quarter/profile views of the three friends gathered on the left and centre, mirror on the right angled toward them, its glass reflecting the three friends naturally with gentle aqua-lilac magic swirls. Frame full figures and complete mirror with breathing room, 16:9 landscape. No new narrative vision inside mirror. Reference 1 is the exact mirror design: oval, gold wave filigree, pearls, pastel diamonds, large heart-shaped lilac crystal below shell crest, elaborate shell pedestal. Preserve it recognisably. Reference 2 is the exact three friends: Odette brown flowing hair lavender clip BLUE eyes, lavender/aqua pink-heart mermaid tail and fully covering scalloped shell bodice; Eclipse lavender skin/hair and curled forelock, purple eyes, tall dark angular purple crystal crown, dark starry dress; Diana very pale pastel flowing hair daisies, tall golden pointed crown with pink jewels, pale-blue gold-trim dress. Keep chibi proportions and distinct crowns. Reference 3 supplies castle style and seven helper identities ONLY, do NOT include Rainbow Ping. The seven tiny floating helpers are: lilac with paired purple eye patches and magenta drooping curled ear lobes; coral pink with low maroon oval face; yellow with ochre eye patches/golden droopy ears; periwinkle with large ice crystal and mismatched purple/cyan polygon eye patches; mint with teal forehead CURL and two round head nubs; cyan with navy diagonal eye patches and NO curl; pink with dark magenta HEART face patch. One of each, all visible, smaller than the three friends, floating curious and cheerful around rather than obstructing the mirror or faces. Reference 4 locks the CORAL helper original design: enormous rounded head about80% height, broad empty forehead, small oval ear nubs, very LOW wide maroon face patch, eyes close together LOW in that patch with large white sclera, tiny pink nose and CLOSED shy curved smile, tiny body. Do not turn it into a teddy bear. Soft undersea daylight through distant arch windows, pale lavender pearl walls, refined gold shell details, glimmering reflections, focus on friends and mirror. One cohesive scene, no panel subdivisions, no words, speech bubbles, captions, logos or watermark.
